description: Find the RSS, Atom or JSON feeds of a website. Reads the page for <link rel="alternate"> feed tags, knows the feed patterns of big platforms (YouTube channels and playlists, Reddit, Medium, Substack, GitHub, Tumblr, Bluesky, Stack Overflow, Apple Podcasts) and tries common feed paths such as /feed and /rss.xml when the page lists none. Returns the candidate feed addresses with format and title. Use when someone asks "does this site have RSS".

website_url.description: Website or page address, e.g. "https://example.com" or "youtube.com/@channel".

name: discover_feeds
title: Find a website's feeds
